name: ast-visitor-pattern
tagline_zh: 当你的联合类型被 2+ 处 switch 拆得七零八落，用 frozen-class 访客模式收拢。改一处。
tagline_en: When your union type is scattered across 2+ switches, freeze it with a visitor. Change once, apply everywhere—no.
desc_en: Use the frozen-class/visitor pattern for discriminated unions that have multiple dispatch sites. Use when creating a new set of variants (commands, IR nodes, factory calls) that will be switched over in 2+ places, or when refactoring an existing union type that has grown multiple switch sites.
why_zh: 比手写 switch 强在：编译器强制你处理所有变体，新增分支时漏改直接报错，而非运行时静默失败。
why_en: Unlike manual switches, the compiler forces handling every variant—miss a case and it fails at build time, not runtime.
